description: The BigQuery job usage settings saved on the GCP connection: bigquery_job_usage and scheduled_query_owners ("on"), and bigquery_job_regions. A setting that is not saved is absent (off, or regions discovered). Never returns credentials. Change them with set_gcp_usage_settings. Mirrors GET /api/accounts/:accountId/connections/gcp/usage-settings.
name: get_gcp_usage_settings
